translations.literal: Open Tongji Lock and release the earthen dam on the relief canal to reduce surging force.
translations.idiomatic: Open Tongji Lock and breach the relief canal's earthen dam to break the force of the flood surge.

sentences.zh: 從其奏。

translations.literal: His memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court accepted his memorial.

sentences.zh: 數年之間，會通上下無阻，而黃、淮並漲，高堰及高郵堤數決害漕。

translations.literal: Within several years, transport above and below the Huitong stretch was unobstructed, but the Yellow and Huai rose together, and Gaojiayan and Gaoyou dikes repeatedly breached, harming transport.
translations.idiomatic: Within a few years the Huitong section ran clear, but the Yellow and Huai rose together, Gaojiayan and the Gaoyou dikes broke again and again, and grain transport suffered.

sentences.zh: 應龍卒罷去。

translations.literal: Shu Yinglong died and was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Shu Yinglong died and was removed from his post.

sentences.zh: 建議者紛紛，未有所定。

translations.literal: Proposals proliferated, and nothing was settled.
translations.idiomatic: Conflicting proposals multiplied, and no settled plan emerged.

sentences.zh: 楊一魁代應龍為總河尚書，力主分黃導淮。

translations.literal: Yang Yikui replaced Shu Yinglong as Grand Coordinator for Rivers and strongly advocated dividing the Yellow River and guiding the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yikui succeeded Shu Yinglong as Grand Coordinator for Rivers and forcefully championed separating the Yellow River from the Huai.

sentences.zh: 治逾年，工將竣，又請決湖水以疏漕渠，言：「高、寶諸湖本沃壤也，自淮、黃逆壅，遂成昏墊。

translations.literal: After more than a year in office, as the work neared completion, he again requested draining lake waters to dredge the transport channel, saying: "The lakes of Gaoyou and Baoying were originally fertile soil; since the Huai and Yellow backed up against them, they became waterlogged marsh.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year in charge, with the work nearly done, he petitioned again to drain the lakes and open the transport channel, arguing: "The Gaoyou and Baoying lakes were once rich farmland; once the Huai and Yellow backed up into them, they turned into boggy marsh.

sentences.zh: 今入江入海之路即浚，宜開治涇河、子嬰溝、金灣河諸閘及瓜、儀二閘，大放湖水，就湖疏渠，與高、寶月河相接。

translations.literal: Now that the routes to the Jiang and the sea have been dredged, we should open and manage the gates of the Jing River, Ziying Gou, Jinwan River, and the Guazhou and Yizheng locks, release the lake waters greatly, dredge channels within the lakes, and connect them with the Gaoyou and Baoying relief canals.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the routes to the Yangzi and the sea have been cleared, we should open the sluices on the Jing River, Ziying Gou, and Jinwan River, along with the locks at Guazhou and Yizheng, release the lake waters in full, dredge channels through the lakes themselves, and link them to the Gaoyou and Baoying relief canals.

sentences.zh: 既避運道風波之險，而水涸成田，給民耕種，漸議起科，可充河費。」

translations.literal: This would both avoid the hazards of wind and waves on the transport route and, when waters receded, expose land for the people to farm; gradually imposing taxes could fund river works."
translations.idiomatic: That would spare the transport route the peril of wind and waves; when the water withdrew, reclaimed land could be given to farmers, taxes could gradually be levied, and the revenue could pay for canal maintenance."

sentences.zh: 命如議行。

translations.literal: An order was issued to proceed as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered that the plan be carried out.

sentences.zh: 時下流既疏，淮水漸帖，而河方決黃堌口。

translations.literal: At the time the lower reaches had already been dredged and Huai waters were gradually subsiding, but the Yellow River had just breached at Huanggu Port.
translations.idiomatic: By then the lower reaches had been cleared and the Huai was subsiding, but the Yellow River had just broken through at Huanggu Port.

sentences.zh: 督漕都御史褚鈇恐泄太多，徐、邳淤阻，力請塞之。

translations.literal: Grain Transport Censor Chu Tie feared too much drainage, silt blockage at Xu and Pi, and strongly requested sealing the breach.
translations.idiomatic: Grain Transport Censor Chu Tie feared that too much water would be lost and Xu and Pi would silt up, and he urgently petitioned to close the breach.

sentences.zh: 一魁持不可，浚兩河口至小浮橋故道以通漕。

translations.literal: Yang Yikui held that this could not be done and dredged from Lianghekou to the old channel at Xiaofu Bridge to open transport.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yikui refused to agree and instead dredged from Lianghekou to the old course at Xiaofu Bridge to keep transport moving.

sentences.zh: 然河大勢南徙，二洪漕屢涸，復大挑黃堌下之李吉口，挽黃以濟之，非久輒淤。

translations.literal: Yet the Yellow River's main force shifted southward; the Erhong transport section repeatedly dried up; they again dredged Lijikou below Huanggu to draw Yellow water to aid it, but within short order it silted up.
translations.idiomatic: But the Yellow River's main current shifted south; the Erhong section of the canal kept drying up; they dredged Lijikou below Huanggu to pull Yellow River water into the channel, yet it silted shut again within little time.

sentences.zh: 一魁入掌部事。

translations.literal: Yang Yikui entered the ministry to take charge of affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yikui entered the ministry to head river affairs.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，劉東星繼之，守一魁舊議，李吉口淤益高。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, Liu Dongxing succeeded him, adhering to Yang Yikui's old plan, while silting at Lijikou grew ever higher.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year Liu Dongxing took over, keeping to Yang Yikui's earlier policy even as Lijikou silted higher and higher.

sentences.zh: 歲冬月，即其地開一小河，春夏引水入徐州，如是者三年，大抵至秋即淤。

translations.literal: Each winter they opened a small canal at that spot and in spring and summer drew water into Xuzhou; this continued for three years, but by autumn it generally silted up.
translations.idiomatic: Each winter they cut a small channel there and in spring and summer led water into Xuzhou; they did this for three years, but by autumn it usually silted shut.

sentences.zh: 乃復開趙家圈以接黃，開泇河以濟運。

translations.literal: They then reopened Zhao Jiaquan to connect with the Yellow River and opened the Jia River to aid transport.
translations.idiomatic: They then reopened Zhao Jiaquan to link with the Yellow River and opened the Jia River to support transport.

sentences.zh: 趙家圈旋淤，泇河未復，而東星卒。

translations.literal: Zhao Jiaquan quickly silted up, the Si River was not restored, and Liu Dongxing died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Jiaquan silted shut almost at once, the Si River remained unrestored, and Liu Dongxing died.

sentences.zh: 於是鳳陽巡撫都御史李三才建議自鎮口閘至磨兒莊仿閘河制，三十里一閘，凡建六閘於河中，節宣汶、濟之水，聊以通漕。

translations.literal: Thereupon Fengyang Grand Coordinator Li Sancai proposed that from Zhenkou Lock to Moerzhuang they follow the lock-canal system, one lock every thirty li, building six locks in all within the river to regulate Wen and Ji waters and barely maintain transport.
translations.idiomatic: Then Fengyang Grand Coordinator Li Sancai proposed adopting the lock-canal system from Zhenkou Lock to Moerzhuang—one lock every thirty li, six locks in all built in the riverbed to regulate Wen and Ji waters and keep transport barely alive.

sentences.zh: 漕舟至京，不復能如期矣。

translations.literal: Grain boats reaching the capital could no longer arrive on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: Grain boats could no longer reach the capital on time.

sentences.zh: 東星在事，開邵伯月河，長十八里，闊十八丈有奇，以避湖險。

translations.literal: While Liu Dongxing was in office, he opened the Shaobo relief canal, eighteen li long and more than eighteen zhang wide, to avoid lake hazards.
translations.idiomatic: During Liu Dongxing's tenure he opened the Shaobo relief canal, eighteen li long and over eighteen zhang wide, to bypass the lake's dangers.

sentences.zh: 又開界首月河，長千八百餘丈。

translations.literal: He also opened the Jieshou relief canal, more than one thousand eight hundred zhang long.
translations.idiomatic: He also opened the Jieshou relief canal, over eighteen hundred zhang in length.

sentences.zh: 各建金門石閘二，漕舟利焉。

translations.literal: At each site two golden-gate stone locks were built, benefiting transport boats.
translations.idiomatic: At each site two golden-gate stone locks were installed, to the great benefit of transport vessels.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，總河侍郎李化龍始大開泇河，自直河至李家港二百六十餘里，盡避黃河之險。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, Vice Coordinator for Rivers Li Hualong at last opened the Si River on a large scale, from Zhihhe to Lijiagang more than two hundred sixty li, completely avoiding Yellow River hazards.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year Vice Coordinator Li Hualong finally opened the Si River in earnest, from Zhihhe to Lijiagang—a stretch of more than two hundred sixty li that wholly bypassed the Yellow River's dangers.

sentences.zh: 化龍憂去，總河侍郎曹時聘終其事，疏敘泇河之功，言：「舒應龍創開韓家莊以泄湖水，而路始通。

translations.literal: Li Hualong left before completion; Vice Coordinator Cao Shipin finished the work and memorialized the achievements of the Si River, saying: "Shu Yinglong first opened Hanjiazhuang to drain lake waters, and the route first became passable.
translations.idiomatic: Li Hualong departed before the work was done; Vice Coordinator Cao Shipin saw it through and memorialized the Si River's achievements, writing: "Shu Yinglong first opened Hanjiazhuang to drain the lakes, and the route first became passable.

sentences.zh: 劉東星大開良城、侯家莊以試行運，而路漸廣。

translations.literal: Liu Dongxing opened Liangcheng and Houjiazhuang on a large scale to trial transport, and the route gradually widened.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Dongxing opened Liangcheng and Houjiazhuang on a large scale to test transport, and the route gradually broadened.

sentences.zh: 李化龍上開李家港，鑿都水石，下開直河口，挑田家莊，殫力經營，行運過半，而路始開，故臣得接踵告竣。」

translations.literal: Li Hualong opened Lijiagang upstream and cut through the Dushui rock; downstream he opened Zhihhekou and dredged Tianjiazhuang, exhausting every effort in the enterprise; transport passed more than halfway, and the route first opened—therefore your servant was able to follow and report completion."
translations.idiomatic: Li Hualong opened Lijiagang upstream and cut through the Dushui rock barrier; downstream he opened Zhihhekou and dredged Tianjiazhuang, pouring every effort into the work until transport was more than halfway restored and the route truly opened—only then could I follow in his steps and report the project finished."

sentences.zh: 因條上善後六事，運道由此大通。

translations.literal: He then listed six follow-up measures, and the transport route was thereby fully opened.
translations.idiomatic: He then submitted six follow-up measures, and from that point the transport route ran clear.

sentences.zh: 其後每年三月開泇河壩，由直河口進，九月開召公壩入黃河，糧艘及官民船悉以為準。

translations.literal: Afterward, each year in the third month the Si River dam was opened and boats entered through Zhihhekou; in the ninth month the Zhaogong dam was opened into the Yellow River—all grain boats and official and private vessels followed this schedule.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, every year in the third month the Si River dam was opened and vessels entered through Zhihhekou; in the ninth month the Zhaogong dam was opened into the Yellow River—grain fleets and all other official and private boats followed this calendar.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，巡漕御史硃堦請修復泉湖，言：「宋禮築壩戴村，奪二汶入海之路，灌以成河，復導洙、泗、洸、沂諸水以佐之。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year, Transport Censor Zhu Jie requested restoring the fountain lakes, saying: "Song Li built the dam at Daicun, diverted both Wen rivers from their routes to the sea, irrigated to form a canal, and again channeled the Zhu, Si, Guang, and Yi waters to assist it.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year Transport Censor Zhu Jie petitioned to restore the fountain lakes, arguing: "Song Li built the Daicun dam, cut off both Wen rivers from their paths to the sea, and impounded them to form a canal, then brought in the Zhu, Si, Guang, and Yi rivers to supplement it.

sentences.zh: 汶雖率眾流出全力以奉漕，然行遠而竭，已自難支。

translations.literal: Although the Wen marshaled all its tributaries and poured its full strength into serving transport, traveling far it was exhausted and already hard to sustain.
translations.idiomatic: Though the Wen gathered every tributary and poured its full force into grain transport, it wore itself out over the long haul and was already hard to sustain.

sentences.zh: 至南旺，又分其四以南迎淮，六以北赴衛，力分益薄。

translations.literal: At Nanwang, four-tenths were again divided south to meet the Huai and six-tenths north toward the Wei, and as force was divided it grew thinner.
translations.idiomatic: At Nanwang four-tenths of its flow was sent south to meet the Huai and six-tenths north toward the Wei, so its strength was spread ever thinner.

sentences.zh: 況此水夏秋則漲，冬春而涸，無雨即夏秋亦涸。

translations.literal: Moreover, this water rose in summer and autumn and dried in winter and spring; without rain even summer and autumn dried up.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the water rose in summer and autumn but failed in winter and spring; without rain even the summer and autumn runs went dry.

sentences.zh: 禮逆慮其不可恃，乃於沿河昭陽、南旺、馬踏、蜀山、安山諸湖設立斗門，名曰水櫃。

translations.literal: Song Li, anticipating that it could not be relied upon, therefore established sluice gates at the lakes along the route—Zhaoyang, Nanwang, Mata, Shushan, and Anshan—called water cabinets.
translations.idiomatic: Song Li foresaw that the Wen alone could not be trusted, and so along the route he installed sluice gates at the lakes of Zhaoyang, Nanwang, Mata, Shushan, and Anshan, called "water cabinets."

sentences.zh: 漕河水漲，則瀦其溢出者於湖，水消則決而注之漕。

translations.literal: When canal water rose, overflow was impounded in the lakes; when water subsided, it was released and poured back into the canal.
translations.idiomatic: When the canal rose, overflow was stored in the lakes; when it fell, the stored water was released back into the canal.

sentences.zh: 積泄有法，盜決有罪，故旱澇恃以無恐。

translations.literal: Accumulation and release had fixed rules; unauthorized opening was a crime—thus drought and flood could be faced without fear.
translations.idiomatic: Storage and release followed strict rules, and unauthorized opening was punishable, so drought and flood could be met without dread.

sentences.zh: 及歲久禁馳，湖淺可耕，多為勢豪所佔，昭陽一湖已作籓田。

translations.literal: As years passed prohibitions lapsed, lakes grew shallow enough to farm, and many were seized by powerful families; Zhaoyang Lake alone had become irrigated fields.
translations.idiomatic: Over time the prohibitions lapsed, the lakes grew shallow enough to plow, and powerful families seized much of the land—Zhaoyang Lake alone had been turned into polder fields.

sentences.zh: 比來山東半年不雨，泉欲斷流，按圖而索水櫃，茫無知者。

translations.literal: Recently Shandong had gone half a year without rain; springs were nearly cut off; searching maps for water cabinets, none could be found.
translations.idiomatic: Recently Shandong had gone half a year without rain, the springs were nearly dry, and when officials searched the maps for water cabinets, none could be found.

sentences.zh: 乞敕河臣清核，亟築堤壩斗門以廣蓄儲。」

translations.literal: I beg that river officials be ordered to investigate and verify, and urgently build dikes, dams, and sluice gates to expand storage."
translations.idiomatic: I beg that river officials be commanded to investigate, and that dikes, dams, and sluice gates be rebuilt at once to expand storage."

sentences.zh: 帝從其請。

translations.literal: The emperor granted his request.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his petition.

sentences.zh: 方議浚泉湖，而河決徐州狼矢溝，由蛤鰻諸湖入泇河，出直口，運船迎溜艱險。

translations.literal: While plans were being made to dredge Quan Lake, the river breached at Langshi Ditch in Xuzhou, entered the Jia River through the Geming lakes, exited at Zhikou, and transport boats faced grave danger running against the current.
translations.idiomatic: While officials were planning to dredge Quan Lake, the river breached at Langshi Ditch in Xuzhou, entered the Jia River through the Geming lakes, exited at Zhikou, and transport boats faced grave danger running against the current.

sentences.zh: 督漕侍郎陳薦開武河等口，泄水準溜。

translations.literal: Grain Transport Vice Minister Chen Jian opened Wukou and other outlets to discharge water and level the current.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Chen Jian, supervising grain transport, opened Wukou and other outlets to discharge water and steady the current.

sentences.zh: 後二年，決口長淤沙，河始復故道。

translations.literal: Two years later the breach silted up with sand and the river at last returned to its old course.
translations.idiomatic: Two years later the breach silted up with sand and the river at last returned to its old course.

sentences.zh: 總河侍郎王佐加築月壩以障之。

translations.literal: Grand Canal Vice Minister Wang Zuo added construction of a moon dam to block it.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Canal Vice Minister Wang Zuo built up a relief dam to block the breach.

sentences.zh: 至泰昌元年冬，佐言：「諸湖水櫃已復，安山湖且復五十五里，誠可利漕。

translations.literal: By the winter of the first year of Taichang, Zuo said: "The lake water cabinets have all been restored, and Anshan Lake will again extend fifty-five li—this truly benefits transport.
translations.idiomatic: By the winter of Taichang 1, Wang Zuo reported: "The lake water cabinets have all been restored, and Anshan Lake will again extend fifty-five li—this truly benefits transport.

sentences.zh: 請以水櫃之廢興為河官殿最。」

translations.literal: I ask that the restoration or loss of the water cabinets be made the chief criterion in evaluating river officials."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that the restoration or loss of the water cabinets be made the chief criterion in evaluating river officials."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: His request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his petition.

sentences.zh: 天啟元年，淮、黃漲溢，決裏河王公祠，淮安知府宋統殷、山陽知縣練國事力塞之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianqi, the Huai and Yellow rose and overflowed, breaching the inner canal at Wanggong Shrine; Huai'an Prefect Song Tongyin and Shanyang Magistrate Lian Guoshi worked hard to seal it.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of the Tianqi reign the Huai and Yellow flooded, breaching the inner canal at Wanggong Shrine; Huai'an Prefect Song Tongyin and Shanyang Magistrate Lian Guoshi strained every effort to close the breach.

sentences.zh: 三年秋，外河復決數口，尋塞。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the third year, the outer river again breached in several places, but was soon sealed.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the third year the outer river broke in several places again, but the breaches were soon closed.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，浚永濟新河。

translations.literal: That winter, the Yongji New Canal was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the Yongji New Canal was dredged.

sentences.zh: 自淩雲翼開是河，未幾而閉。

translations.literal: Since Ling Yunyi opened this canal, before long it was closed.
translations.idiomatic: Ever since Ling Yunyi had opened this canal, it had been closed again before long.

sentences.zh: 總河都御史劉士忠嘗開壩以濟運，已復塞。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Liu Shizhong had once opened the dam to aid transport, but it had again been sealed.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Liu Shizhong had once opened the dam to support transport, but it had been sealed again.

sentences.zh: 而淮安正河三十年未浚。

translations.literal: Yet Huai'an's main canal had not been dredged in thirty years.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Huai'an's main canal had gone thirty years without dredging.

sentences.zh: 故議先挑新河，通運船回空，乃浚正河，自許家閘至惠濟祠長千四百餘丈，復建通濟月河小閘，運船皆由正河，新河復閉。

translations.literal: Therefore the plan was first to dredge the new canal to pass returning empty transport boats, then dredge the main canal from Xujia Lock to Huiji Shrine more than one thousand four hundred zhang, rebuild the Tongji relief canal's small lock, route all transport boats through the main canal, and close the new canal again.
translations.idiomatic: The plan was therefore to dredge the new canal first so returning empty boats could pass, then dredge the main channel from Xujia Lock to Huiji Shrine—a stretch of more than fourteen hundred zhang—rebuild the small lock on the Tongji relief canal, route all transport boats through the main canal, and close the new canal once more.

sentences.zh: 時王家集、磨兒莊湍溜日甚，漕儲參政硃國盛謀改浚一河以為漕計，令同知宋士中自泇口迤東抵宿遷陳溝口，復泝駱馬湖，上至馬頰河，往回相度。

translations.literal: At the time the currents at Wangjiaji and Moerzhuang grew fiercer by the day; Transport Storage Vice Commissioner Zhu Guosheng planned to dredge a new canal for transport, ordering Vice Prefect Song Shizhong to survey from Sikou eastward to Chenggoukou at Suqian, then upstream through Luoma Lake to Majia River, going back and forth to measure the route.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the rapids at Wangjiaji and Moerzhuang grew worse daily; Transport Storage Vice Commissioner Zhu Guosheng planned to cut a new canal for grain transport and sent Vice Prefect Song Shizhong to survey from Sikou east to Chenggoukou at Suqian, then upstream through Luoma Lake to the Majia River, traveling back and forth to assess the route.

sentences.zh: 乃議開馬家洲，且疏馬頰河口淤塞，上接泇流，下避劉口之險，又疏三汊河流沙十三里，開滔莊河百餘丈，浚深小河二十里，開王能莊二十里，以通駱馬湖口，築塞張家等溝數十道，束水歸漕。

translations.literal: They then proposed opening Majiazhou, dredging the silted Majia River mouth, connecting upstream to the Jia flow, avoiding downstream the hazard of Liukou, dredging thirteen li of sand at Sancha River, opening more than one hundred zhang of Taozhuang River, deepening a small stream twenty li, opening Wangnengzhuang twenty li to reach Luoma Lake's mouth, and building and sealing dozens of channels such as Zhangjia to constrain water back to the transport route.
translations.idiomatic: They then proposed opening Majiazhou, clearing the silted Majia River mouth, linking upstream to the Jia flow, bypassing the danger of Liukou downstream, dredging thirteen li of sand at Sancha River, opening more than a hundred zhang of Taozhuang River, deepening a small stream for twenty li, opening Wangnengzhuang for twenty li to reach Luoma Lake's mouth, and blocking dozens of side channels such as Zhangjia to force water back into the transport route.

sentences.zh: 計河五十七里，名通濟新河。

translations.literal: The canal totaled fifty-seven li and was named the Tongji New Canal.
translations.idiomatic: The canal totaled fifty-seven li and was named the Tongji New Canal.

sentences.zh: 五年四月，工成，運道從新河，無劉口、磨兒莊諸險之患。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fifth year the work was completed; the transport route followed the new canal, free from the hazards of Liukou, Moerzhuang, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fifth year the work was finished; the transport route ran through the new canal, free from the dangers of Liukou, Moerzhuang, and the like.

sentences.zh: 明年，總河侍郎李從心開陳溝地十里，以竟前工。

translations.literal: The next year, Vice Coordinator Li Congxin opened ten li at Chenggou to complete the earlier work.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Vice Coordinator Li Congxin opened ten li at Chenggou to finish the earlier project.

sentences.zh: 崇禎二年，淮安蘇家嘴、新溝大壩並決，沒山、鹽、高、泰民田。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongzhen, Huai'an's Sujiazui and Xingou great dams both breached, inundating farmland in Shanyang, Yan, Gaoyou, and Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Chongzhen reign the great dams at Sujiazui and Xingou in Huai'an both failed, flooding farmland in Shanyang, Yan, Gaoyou, and Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 五年，又決建義北壩。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Jianyi North Dam also breached.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Jianyi North Dam breached as well.

sentences.zh: 總河尚書硃光祚浚駱馬湖，避河險十三處，名順濟河。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Zhu Guangzuo dredged Luoma Lake, avoiding thirteen river hazards, and named it the Shunji River.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Zhu Guangzuo dredged Luoma Lake, bypassing thirteen dangerous stretches of river, and named the channel the Shunji River.

sentences.zh: 六年，良城至徐塘淤為平陸，漕運愆期，奪光祚官，劉榮嗣繼之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Liangcheng to Xutang silted into level land; grain transport missed its schedule; Zhu Guangzuo was stripped of office, and Liu Rongsi succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the stretch from Liangcheng to Xutang silted up into flat ground, grain transport fell behind schedule, Zhu Guangzuo was dismissed, and Liu Rongsi took his place.

sentences.zh: 八年，駱馬湖淤阻，榮嗣開河徐、宿，引注黃水，被劾，得重罪。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Luoma Lake silted and blocked transport; Liu Rongsi opened a canal in Xu and Su to draw in Yellow River water, was impeached, and received severe punishment.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Luoma Lake silted shut; Liu Rongsi cut a canal in Xu and Su to introduce Yellow River water, was impeached, and received a heavy sentence.

sentences.zh: 侍郎周鼎繼之，乃專力於泇河，浚麥河支河，築王母山前後壩、勝陽山東堤、馬蹄厓十字河攔水壩，挑良城閘抵徐塘口六千餘丈。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Zhou Ding succeeded him and then focused entirely on the Si River, dredging the Mai River branch canal, building dams before and after Wangmushan, Shengyangshan's east dike, and Matiya's cross-river water-blocking dam, and dredging more than six thousand zhang from Liangcheng Lock to Xutangkou.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Zhou Ding succeeded him and devoted himself entirely to the Si River, dredging the Mai River branch, building dams before and after Wangmushan, the east dike at Shengyangshan, and the cross-river blocking dam at Matiya, and dredging more than six thousand zhang from Liangcheng Lock to Xutangkou.

sentences.zh: 九年夏，泇河復通，由宿遷陳溝口合大河。

translations.literal: In the summer of the ninth year, the Si River was open again, joining the great river at Chenggoukou in Suqian.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the ninth year the Si River opened again, joining the great river at Chenggoukou in Suqian.

sentences.zh: 鼎又修高家堰及新溝漾田營堤，增築天妃閘石工，去南旺湖彭口沙礓，浚劉呂莊至黃林莊百六十里。

translations.literal: Zhou Ding also repaired Gaojiayan and the Xingou Yangtiancamp dike, added stonework at Tianfei Lock, removed sand and gravel at Pengkou in Nanwang Lake, and dredged one hundred sixty li from Liuluzhuang to Huanglinzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Ding also repaired Gaojiayan and the Xingou Yangtiancamp dike, reinforced the stonework at Tianfei Lock, cleared sand and gravel from Pengkou in Nanwang Lake, and dredged a hundred and sixty li from Liuluzhuang to Huanglinzhuang.

sentences.zh: 而是時黃、淮漲溢日甚，倒灌害漕。

translations.literal: Yet at this time the Yellow and Huai rose and overflowed daily, backflowing and harming transport.
translations.idiomatic: Yet by then the Yellow and Huai flooded more fiercely by the day, backflowing and wrecking grain transport.

sentences.zh: 鼎在事五年，卒以運阻削職。

translations.literal: Zhou Ding served five years in office and ultimately was stripped of rank because transport was blocked.
translations.idiomatic: After five years in office Zhou Ding was finally dismissed for failing to keep transport moving.

sentences.zh: 繼之者侍郎張國維，甫蒞任，即以漕涸被責。

translations.literal: His successor was Vice-Minister Zhang Guowei, who upon taking office was immediately rebuked because transport had run dry.
translations.idiomatic: He was succeeded by Vice-Minister Zhang Guowei, who was rebuked as soon as he took office because the transport route had dried up.

sentences.zh: 十四年，國維言：「濟甯運道自棗林閘溯師家莊、仲家淺二閘，歲患淤淺，每引泗河由魯橋入運以濟之。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, Guowei said: "The Jining transport route from Zaolin Sluice upstream through Shijiazhuang and Zhongjia Shallow—the two sluices—suffered silting and shallowness every year; each time the Si River was diverted through Luqiao into the transport canal to supply it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, Guowei reported: "The Jining transport route from Zaolin Sluice upstream through the Shijiazhuang and Zhongjia Shallow sluices was plagued by silting every year; the Si River was regularly diverted through Luqiao into the transport canal to supplement it.

sentences.zh: 伏秋水長，足資利涉。

translations.literal: When flood season brought high water, it was sufficient for easy passage.
translations.idiomatic: During the flood season, when water was high, passage was easy.

sentences.zh: 而挾沙注河，水退沙積，利害參半。

translations.literal: Yet it carried sand into the canal; when the water receded the sand accumulated—benefit and harm were evenly matched.
translations.idiomatic: Yet it carried sand into the canal, and when the water fell the sand built up—gains and losses were about equal.

sentences.zh: 旁自白馬河匯鄒縣諸泉，與泗合流而出魯橋，力弱不能敵泗，河身半淤，不為漕用。

translations.literal: Nearby, the Baima River gathered the springs of Zou County, joined the Si, and flowed out at Luqiao; its force was too weak to match the Si, the channel was half silted, and it could not serve transport.
translations.idiomatic: Nearby, the Baima River collected the springs of Zou County, merged with the Si, and exited at Luqiao; being too weak to counter the Si, its channel was half silted and could not serve transport.

sentences.zh: 然其上源寬處正與仲家淺閘相對，導令由此入運，較魯橋高下懸殊，且易細流為洪流，又減沙滲之患，而濟仲家淺及師莊、棗林，有三便。」

translations.literal: Yet its upper reach, where the channel widens, lay directly opposite Zhongjia Shallow Sluice; diverting it there into the transport canal offered three advantages over Luqiao: the elevation difference was far less, a small stream could become a mighty current, and sand infiltration would be reduced—thus aiding Zhongjia Shallow as well as Shizhuang and Zaolin."
translations.idiomatic: Yet where its upper reach widened, it lay directly opposite Zhongjia Shallow Sluice; diverting it there into the transport canal offered three advantages over Luqiao: the drop in elevation was much smaller, a narrow stream could become a strong current, sand infiltration would be reduced, and Zhongjia Shallow together with Shizhuang and Zaolin would all be supplied."

sentences.zh: 又言：「南旺水本地脊，惟藉泰安、新泰、萊蕪、甯陽、汶上、東平、平陰、肥城八州縣泉源，由汶入運，故運河得通。

translations.literal: He also said: "Nanwang water sits on the watershed ridge; the transport canal could flow only by relying on the springs of the eight prefectures and counties of Tai'an, Xintai, Laiwu, Ningyang, Wenshang, Dongping, Pingyin, and Feicheng, entering the canal through the Wen River.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Nanwang sits on the watershed ridge; the transport canal remained open only because it drew on springs from Tai'an, Xintai, Laiwu, Ningyang, Wenshang, Dongping, Pingyin, and Feicheng, which entered through the Wen River.

sentences.zh: 今東平、平陰、肥城淤沙中斷，請亟浚之。」

translations.literal: Now Dongping, Pingyin, and Feicheng are cut off by silt; I beg that they be dredged at once."
translations.idiomatic: Now Dongping, Pingyin, and Feicheng are blocked by silt; I request that they be dredged immediately."

sentences.zh: 復上疏運六策：一復安山湖水櫃以濟北閘，一改挑滄浪河從萬年倉出口以利四閘，一展浚汶河、陶河上源以濟邳派，一改道沂河出徐塘口以並利邳、宿，其二即開三州縣淤沙及改挑白馬湖也。

translations.literal: He further submitted six policies for transport: restore Anshan Lake's water cabinets to supply the northern sluices; reroute the Canglang River from Wannian Granary's outlet to benefit four sluices; extend dredging of the upper reaches of the Wen and Tao Rivers to aid the Pi branch; redirect the Yi River to exit at Xutang Mouth to benefit both Pi and Su; the remaining two were to clear silt in the three prefectures and counties and reroute the Baima Lake channel.
translations.idiomatic: He further submitted six policies for transport: restore Anshan Lake's water cabinets to supply the northern sluices; reroute the Canglang River from Wannian Granary's outlet to benefit four sluices; extend dredging of the upper Wen and Tao Rivers to aid the Pi branch; redirect the Yi River to exit at Xutang Mouth to benefit both Pi and Su; the remaining two called for clearing silt in the three prefectures and counties and rerouting the Baima Lake channel.

sentences.zh: 皆命酌行。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered each to be implemented as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered each measure to be carried out as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 國維又浚淮、揚漕河三百餘里。

translations.literal: Guowei also dredged more than three hundred li of the Huai and Yang transport canals.
translations.idiomatic: Guowei also dredged more than three hundred li of the Huai and Yang transport canals.

sentences.zh: 當是時，河臣竭力補苴，南河稍寧，北河數淺阻。

translations.literal: At that time river officials strained every effort to patch and mend; the southern route grew somewhat stable, while the northern route repeatedly shoaled and blocked.
translations.idiomatic: At that time river officials strained every effort to patch and mend; the southern route grew somewhat stable, while the northern route repeatedly shoaled and blocked transport.

sentences.zh: 而河南守臣壅黃河以灌賊。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Henan's defending officials dammed the Yellow River to flood the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Henan's defending officials dammed the Yellow River to flood the rebels.

sentences.zh: 河大決開封，下流日淤，河事益壞，未幾而明亡矣。

translations.literal: The river breached massively at Kaifeng; the lower reaches silted day by day; river affairs grew ever worse—and before long the Ming dynasty fell.
translations.idiomatic: The river breached catastrophically at Kaifeng; the lower reaches silted up daily; river management deteriorated further—and before long the Ming dynasty fell.
